headlines.description: Case Keenum threw for two touchdowns and ran for a score all in the first half to give the Minnesota Vikings a double-digit lead and they went on to beat the Detroit Lions 30-23 Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keenum-led Vikings beat Lions 30-23, adding to division lead

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 434 yards and three touchdowns in his first Thanksgiving game in his 14th season and the Los Angeles Chargers beat the fading Dallas Cowboys 28-6 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers, Chargers beat fading Cowboys 28-6 on Thanksgiving

events.name: New York Giants at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw two touchdown passes to compensate for a pick-six and the Washington Redskins beat the New York Giants 20-10 on Thursday night on a drab field in a drab game between two injury-depleted teams that did not look ready for prime time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins beat Giants 20-10 in turkey of a Thanksgiving game

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Rookie Joe Mixon ran for a career-high 114 yards in the Cincinnati Bengals' best offensive showing since the last time they faced Cleveland, a 30-16 victory Sunday that sent the Browns into December still winless for the second year in a row.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mixon runs for 114, Bengals beat winless Browns 30-16

headlines.description: The Titans (7-4) got their first win in 10 tries at Lucas Oil Stadium when DeMarco Murray scored on a 1-yard touchdown run with 5:59 left Sunday for a 20-16 come-from-behind win over Indianapolis.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans rally to beat Colts 20-16, snap losing streak at Indy

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Tyrod Taylor threw for 183 yards and a touchdown in his return to the starting lineup, Tre'Davious White intercepted Alex Smith with just over a minute remaining, and the Buffalo Bills held off Kansas City Chiefs 16-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills pick off Smith in closing minutes, beat Chiefs 16-10

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady tossed four touchdown passes -- including two to Rob Gronkowski -- and the New England Patriots pushed through injuries and a mistake-filled game to beat the Miami Dolphins 35-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws for 4 TDs, Patriots beat Dolphins 35-17

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New York Jets

headlines.description: Luke Kuechly returned a fumble 34 yards for a touchdown and Kaelin Clay had a 60-yard punt return for a score, capping a stunning swing in the fourth quarter that lifted the Carolina Panthers to a 35-27 comeback win over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kuechly, Clay lead Panthers to 35-27 comeback win over Jets

headlines.description: Carson Wentz tossed three touchdown passes and the NFL-leading Philadelphia Eagles beat the Chicago Bears 31-3 Sunday for their ninth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carson Wentz tosses 3 touchdowns, Eagles beat Bears 31-3

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for two touchdowns to give him 150 career TDs passing and also ran for a short score, and the Seattle Seahawks overcame a sloppy start to beat the San Francisco 49ers 24-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws for 2 TDs, runs for another as Seahawks win

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Phil Dawson kicked a career-long 57-yard field goal with one second to play to give the Arizona Cardinals a 27-24 victory over Jacksonville on Sunday, snapping the Jaguars' four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dawson's 57-yard FG gives Arizona win over Jacksonville

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Chris Boswell kicked a career-long 53-yard field goal as time expired to give the Pittsburgh Steelers a 31-28 victory over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday night.

Terrell Suggs led an aggressive Baltimore defense that kept Houston out of the end zone for the final 51 minutes, and the Ravens went deep in the playbook on offense to squeeze out a 23-16 victory on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suggs, Ravens get defensive in 23-16 win over Texans
